title: ME60419: Modeling And Simulation Of Dynamic Systems
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Elements of analytical mechanics; classification of constrains, Principles of
virtual work, Lagrange;s first equation. Lagrange’s second equation. Hamilton’s
equations. Nonholonomic mechanical system dynamics, Routh and Gibb?s equation,
Kane dynamics with application to multi body systems like mechanisms and
manipulators. Modelling of systems involving continuous medium. Hamilton’s
principle for continuous medium. Elements of thermo-continuum and theory of
constitutive relations. Advanced topics in bond graph moedlling of physical
systems : Elements of multi-bond graphs, Thermo-mechanical bond graphs and
continuous systems and other systems of typical interest. Introduction to
various system simulation software.
